description: Ministry of Labour - The Industrial Disputes between Mr. H. M. R. Kumaratunga Vs. Sri Lanka Transport Board Colombo as and Sri Lanka Transport Board Monaragala Depot. - Mr. K. G. C. R. Bandara Vs. Sri Lanka Transport Board Colombo 05 (S & E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of arbitrators to settle industrial disputes under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal orders issued by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment, referencing specific legislative enactments and their amendments. The core content is about implementing legal/regulatory procedures for dispute resolution, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organisational structure, or other specialized categories.
